title: Pinned tensor pullback comparisons are associative on homotopy categories
statement: For scheme morphisms h:W→X, f:X→Y, g:Y→Z [def-pc-scheme], suppose each tensor pullback is additive. Let T_k be the functor induced on homotopy categories of module cochain complexes by tensorPullback k [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], and let t(f,g):T_g⋙T_f≅T_(f≫g) be mapHomotopyCategoryCompIso of the adjunction conjugate of pushforwardComp(f,g) inverse, using exactly the adjunctions chosen from exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction. At every homotopy complex H of O_Z-modules, T_h.map(t(f,g).hom.app H) followed by t(h,f≫g).hom.app H equals t(h,f).hom.app(T_g.obj H) followed by t(h≫f,g).hom.app H. The total composite morphisms are identified by Category.assoc, whose transport has identity components here. No derived category, derived comparison, counit, or K-flat hypothesis is used.

proof.text: Apply Adjunction.leftAdjointCompIso_assoc to the pinned adjunctions for g, f, h, f≫g, h≫f, and the total composite. The required pushforward isomorphism equality follows by extensionality on sheaves and sections and the identity-component formulas for pushforwardComp.

Write H as the homotopy quotient of a complex P. Each homotopy comparison component is the quotient map of the termwise comparison component. Combine consecutive quotient maps, reduce equality to a complex morphism equality, and check each degree by evaluating the underived adjunction associativity equality at P.X i.

theorem tensorPullback_homotopy_comp_assoc
    (a : ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u₁}} (f : X ⟶ Y), (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).Additive)
    {W X Y Z : Scheme.{u₁}} (h : W ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (H : HomotopyCategory Z.Modules (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) :
    let T {X Y : Scheme.{u₁}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :=
    (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    let t {X Y Z : Scheme.{u₁}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :=
    Functor.mapHomotopyCategoryCompIso
      ((conjugateIsoEquiv
        (Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (f ≫ g)))
        ((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction g)).comp
          (Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction f)))).symm
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f g).symm) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    (T h).map ((t f g).hom.app H) ≫ (t h (f ≫ g)).hom.app H =
      (t h f).hom.app ((T g).obj H) ≫ (t (h ≫ f) g).hom.app H
